requirements.Title: HP’s First Business Ink Tank Printer for SMBs
requirements.Description: Develop and launch HP’s first business ink tank printer (Magellan) specifically targeted at unmanaged to lightly managed SMBs (5-250 employees, 6-15 printers, AMPV ~500 pages) with no dedicated IT team.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses a gap in HP’s portfolio for CISS PLE Hi segment and helps retain SMB market share.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: A new business ink tank printer is developed and launched, targeting SMBs as defined, and is available for purchase.

requirements.Title: AI Productivity, Scan Workflow & Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-powered productivity features, scan workflow automation, and manageability solutions into Magellan to simplify business operations for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Provides differentiated value to SMBs by reducing manual intervention and enhancing efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI software and workflow integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI-powered features for productivity, scan workflow automation, and device manageability are available and functional on the device and portal.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO with Minimal Intervention
requirements.Description: Design Magellan to deliver the lowest total cost of ownership (TCO) for SMBs, with minimal user intervention required for maintenance and operation.
requirements.Rationale: Key purchase driver for SMBs focused on ROI and efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires efficient consumable design, maintenance minimization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO is demonstrably lower than competitive SMB printers, with maintenance intervals and interventions minimized per HP benchmarks.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – Minimum 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure at least 60% of the printer’s plastic content is made from recycled materials, exceeding competitor standards (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP’s sustainability leadership and is a key differentiator for Magellan.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: BOM and manufacturing reports confirm at least 60% of plastics are recycled content.

requirements.Title: Customer-Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Implement a maintenance box that is easily replaceable by customers, reducing the need for service center visits and downtime.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses key pain point for SMBs with limited IT support and supports serviceability goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by end users without tools or technical support, as validated by usability testing.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal (SMB portal) for easy management of printers, targeting unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Simplifies device management for non-IT-trained office managers/generalists and enhances user experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Portal software development, integration with device telemetry.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is available, supports device management for multiple printers, and is accessible to SMB users as defined.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability: 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty of 80,000 pages or 2 years (whichever is first) and ensure key components (PHA, MINK) are customer-replaceable or serviceable at the service center post-warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces SMB downtime and supports cost-effective ownership.
requirements.Dependencies: Component design for replaceability, warranty policy alignment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty is clearly stated in product documentation; service parts are available and replaceable as specified.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Consumables
requirements.Description: Use keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and support ease of use for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes user errors and supports maintenance-free experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Only correctly keyed bottles can be used for refilling; validated by testing.

requirements.Title: Support for SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB Portal (Non-PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: Non-PDL SKUs must support SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal for enhanced device management and reporting.
requirements.Rationale: Provides advanced features to non-PDL customers, supporting broad SMB needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKUs support SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View portal as verified in QA.

requirements.Title: Support for PDL/PS, Speed Improvements, and Blue Angel Certification (PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: PDL SKUs must support PDL/PS, achieve speed targets of 25/20 ppm, and meet Blue Angel environmental certification.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures competitive performance and compliance for advanced SMB use cases.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware and hardware development, certification processes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKUs meet speed, feature, and certification requirements as validated by testing and certification documentation.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan AI Solutions
requirements.Description: Develop and integrate AI-driven Perfect Print and Perfect Scan solutions to optimize output quality and workflow efficiency.
requirements.Rationale: Differentiates Magellan in the SMB market and addresses customer needs for high-quality, efficient print/scan.
requirements.Dependencies: AI algorithm development, integration with device firmware and portal.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan features are available, functional, and deliver measurable improvements in quality and workflow efficiency.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Enable mobile printing capabilities and seamless integration with the HP App for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: Supports modern SMB workflows and enhances product accessibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing is available via HP App and validated with SMB user scenarios.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Platform as a Service) Support
requirements.Description: Magellan must support HP’s PaaS model, enabling solutions enhancement, monetization, and future feature delivery.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with HP’s strategic intent to accelerate PaaS adoption and revenue.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS features are enabled and functional as per business requirements.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements for Device Monitoring
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features to support remote monitoring, diagnostics, and management of Magellan printers for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Enables proactive support, analytics, and device management, reducing downtime for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is available, accurate, and accessible via the SMB portal or designated interfaces.
